title: docs(contributing): Use squash instead of rebase
body:
I think what we want to say is that we should squash commits together
to remove the unnecessary and temporary commits before accepting the
PR. We still use rebase when keeping in sync with develop.

comments.body: I think we meant `rebase -i`. For some PRs it makes sense not squashing them all. But this is clearer.
Yes, this will actually go through `rebase -i` where you can then squash them. I felt that _merge_ should be used for branches and _squash_ for commits.

Yes we meant "you need to rebase your pull request to avoid commits". But there's no "git squash" command so I wonder if that's clearer.

I am adding a link to http://gitready.com/advanced/2009/02/10/squashing-commits-with-rebase.html to make it clearer
